brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Seamline, the open-source command-line tool in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: precise, trustworthy, developer-native; it must work in a terminal-heavy README, as a GitHub avatar and on a small docs site. No database cylinders, no elephants, no generic terminal prompt. Web and GitHub only.

claim.notes: All three directions (lane-shift, stitch-steps, split-s) got sketch-pick none in two sketch reviews, so none reached develop, verify or the gate; no export or gallery was produced.

concepts.title: Lane shift
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 split disc; s7 app tile with notch (UI icon); s8 striped disc (vent grille/barcode); s9 tile with diagonal slash (slash, S with cut). All struck: stock disc/slash/grille the brief bans. Try a non-disc, non-tile form where the seam is the silhouette itself, not a cut through a stock shape.

concepts.title: Split S
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 sheared disc (cut disc); s7 two overlapping squares (generic, UI/layers); s8 two stepped blocks (Tetris/layers); s9 two offset petals (S monogram with offset, generic leaf). All are initial-with-offset or stock shapes. Try a form not built on S or a split/slid copy.

concepts.title: Stitch steps
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 stepped blob/Tetris-like block; s6 chevron or K / arrow; s7 needle (explicitly banned); s8 slashed disc (stock disc/slash, weak at 16px). Struck. Try a stitch as a distinct drawn shape not built from slanted pills in a disc.
